title: Tatkal 1 minute me full kyun ho jaata hai?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Das baje Tatkal khula... ek minute me WAITING!
Aadhe se zyada koshishein... bots ki thi!
Form pehle se bhara, captcha khud solve.
Tum type karte raho... seat gayi!
Ye reel Tatkal me haare dost ko bhejo!
caption:
10 baje Tatkal khula... aur 1 minute me sab WAITING? 😤

Railway ministry ne July 2026 me Lok Sabha me bataya: online ticket booking ki lagbhag 58% requests bots ki thi! Gair-kaanooni software form pehle se bhar ke rakhte the, captcha khud solve karte the aur kayi IDs se ek saath booking karte the. Ek LocalCircles survey me 73% logon ne kaha ki booking khulte hi pehle minute me tickets khatam.

Isliye ab Tatkal online ke liye Aadhaar authentication zaroori hai (kuch trains me Aadhaar OTP bhi), anti-bot system lagaya gaya hai, aur lagbhag 3 crore suspicious IDs band ki gayi hain. 🚆

Agla "kaise" kis cheez ka chahiye? Comment karo 👇
